summary: I read the reservation path (create-reservations, reserve-inventory, inventory-module createReservationItems_ and ensureInventoryLevels). Same-process reservations are serialized by a per-inventory-item lock, but the default locking provider is InMemoryLockingProvider, which does not coordinate across the two servers in a 2-server run. The inventory level update is also a read-modify-write of reserved_quantity computed from a value read before the lock-free update, so cross-server races could leave reserved_quantity out of sync with the reservation rows or oversell. I submitted two scenarios (a cross-server WIDGET race, and a same-server two-pack race) to test this. I have not seen their results, so no problem is confirmed yet. Claiming attempt 1 as a hypothesis only, pending its outcome.
